title: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E), Employer's Tax Guide, for use in 2026
note: 59 pages. Payroll guide: social security, Medicare, supplemental wages and backup withholding. The income tax withholding tables for regular wages are not in it (it refers to Pub. 15-T).

title: IRS Publication 505, Tax Withholding and Estimated Tax, for use in 2026
note: 48 pages, mostly prose. Chapter 1 states the withholding rules cited here (gambling winnings, pensions, eligible rollover distributions, backup withholding). Chapter 2 is estimated tax, not withholding.

title: IRS Revenue Procedure 2023-34, inflation-adjusted items for 2024
note: 27 pages. Income tax brackets and other inflation-adjusted amounts for taxable years beginning in 2024. It states no withholding rate.

title: CRA T4032-ON, Payroll Deductions Tables: CPP, EI, and income tax deductions, Ontario, effective January 1, 2026
note: 16 pages. The URL in the exercise statement (t4032on-1-26e.pdf, without hyphens) no longer serves the PDF; this is the current official version of the same document.

title: DIAN Resolución 000238 de 2025 (valor de la UVT para 2026)
note: HTML without pages, in Spanish: every citation uses page 1. It only sets the value of the tax value unit (UVT) for 2026, written $52.374 (52374 pesos). It states no withholding rate.
